notes.title: Hear! Hear! LookVR 1.2 is... here!
notes.content:
Hey, long time no see! We've put together some enhancements to LookVR that should make it easier to set up, easier to learn, and easier to use.
[list]
[*] Added a tutorial that teaches you how to use the menu system and controls
[*] Added sound effects for the UI and environment
[*] Added a grid effect underneath visualizations when they extend outside of the play area
[*] Redesigned the menu system to be easier to use and more visually appealing
[*] Additional options for customizing a query once it's been run
[*] Improved error messages for network, authentication, and other errors that should make it easier to connect to Looker
[*] Added experimental support for macOS
[*] Lots of bug fixes and enhancements
[/list]

notes.title: LookVR 1.1 – Now with Oculus Touch!
notes.content:
We've updated LookVR with some fun new stuff:

[list]
    [*] Oculus Touch support
    [*] New options for tinkering with charts by adding or removing fields
    [*] Cleaner and friendlier menu system
    [*] Haptic feedback for clickable items
    [*] Enhanced background graphics
    [*] #branding
    [*] "Big Data" mode is easier to climb and can be exited by pressing the menu button if you get stuck.
    [*] Tons of bug fixes and minor UI cleanup
[/list]
